verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents CPU cores and clocks, NPU TOPS, and LPDDR5x memory bandwidth. Nothing covers PCIe generation or lane count, storage interfaces, or external connectivity such as USB4 or display outputs. Memory bandwidth is a related but different spec, and the ASUS mini-PC item is only a headline with no I/O details, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, the platform has documented I/O headroom — PCIe generation and lanes, fast storage, and external connectivity specs I can plan a build or dock setup around
